primary.title: An Essay Concerning Human Understanding
primary.author: John Locke
primary.rationale: Locke's magnum opus, a foundational text in empiricism and epistemology. Widely available in digital formats.

primary.title: Two Treatises of Government
primary.author: John Locke
primary.rationale: A seminal work of political philosophy, arguing for natural rights and government by consent. Essential for understanding his political thought.

primary.title: A Letter Concerning Toleration
primary.author: John Locke
primary.rationale: An influential argument for religious tolerance, advocating for the separation of church and state.

secondary.title: Locke: A Very Short Introduction

secondary.title: John Locke's Political Philosophy: An Historical Analysis of His Major Writings

secondary.rationale: While older, Strauss's analysis remains a significant and often-cited interpretation of Locke's political thought, though newer scholarship provides updated perspectives.
